analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (67,785 KRW) below SMA5 (85,174 KRW)/SMA20 (103,262 KRW)/SMA50 (103,992 KRW): confirming weak short-to-medium term trend position.
· Significantly below SMA100 (136,378 KRW)/SMA200 (111,471 KRW): indicating weakened long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (15.2%) + current price range near 52-week low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.2 → 24.5): confirmed entry into oversold territory, a zone for potential rebound.
· MACD histogram trajectory (233.2412 → -4323.5106): continued worsening, confirming a bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (lower band 77,898 KRW): approaching the lower band, with band width expanded to 49.12%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (66,180 KRW): aligning with 5-day/20-day lows, expected to act as a key support.
· Swing resistance (80,380 KRW): the first resistance level on a short-term rebound.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: Lower High pattern confirmed, signaling continued downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 1.88: accompanied by increased volume, confirming the strength of the decline.
· Current phase diagnosis: Bearish trend phase, potential for a rebound due to short-term oversold entry, but no trend reversal signal confirmed. Wait-and-see conditions.
